mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feedback (type, title, description, contact, images, status, user_id, user_name, reply, handler_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{type}, #{title}, #{description}, #{contact}, #{images}, #{status}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{reply}, #{handlerId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feedback WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM feedback WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM feedback WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE feedback SET type = #{type}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, contact = #{contact}, images = #{images}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as processing, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'resolved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as resolved, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as closed FROM feedback
